[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/L4IhetvC/lively-places-fund#main-content) # Lively Places Fund - SupportGoWhere Lively Places Fund Share link Provides funding of up to $20,000 for community-driven projects that enhance public spaces and foster community bonds. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Funding of up to $5,000 for small, short-term community projects - Funding of up to $20,000 for eligible larger projects - Traffic redirection support provided for street events [Apply now](https://oursggrants.gov.sg/grants/hdblpfopn/instruction) Expand all sections About this support The funds awarded will depend on the type and scale of the project. Please refer to the below table for a detailed breakdown: | Category | Award Sum | Description | | Project fund | Up to $5,000 | For smaller, short-term action plans or activities for community bonding in HDB neighbourhoods
e.g. block parties, anti-littering campaign, community recycling day | | Building Fund | Up to $5,000 | For projects that will involve a physical transformation of existing public spaces and have an implementation period of 6 months or less
e.g. community arts projects and short-term pop-up installations to activate spaces | | Up to $20,000 | For projects that will involve a physical transformation of existing public spaces and have an implementation period of more than 6 months
e.g. conversion of void decks into community living rooms and cafes, longer-term pop-up installations to activate spaces | | Street Closure | N/A | For short-term projects that transform streets into active public spaces for the community
Support provided will be limited to road closure essentials, consisting of safety barriers, signage and security personnel | Who is this for? - Open to all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents - Individual or team applicants, with at least 1 applicant above 17 years old - Not for projects already funded by other agencies - Co-funding between agencies may be considered for new projects if the project meets the fund’s objectives - Previous awardees must complete existing projects before reapplying - Cannot support projects that duplicate existing programmes - Does not cover projects or studies started before funding approval - All proposals will be reviewed based on the following criteria: - Fund objective - Level of neighbourhood involvment - Level of community match - Outcomes Refer to the [HDB InfoWEB](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/living-in-my-community/enlivening-my-neighbourhood/lively-places-programme/lively-places-fund-and-challenge) for more information regarding the criteria. How to apply? Please visit [https://go.gov.sg/hdb-osglpf-application](https://go.gov.sg/hdb-osglpf-application) Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/living-in-my-community/enlivening-my-neighbourhood/lively-places-programme/lively-places-fund-and-challenge) * * * [View application details](https://go.gov.sg/hdb-osglpf-application) * * * View your nearest HDB branch [here](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/about-us/contact-us).
